svg.title: The built-in types as sets. Values are primitives or objects. Among the primitives, int is inside ratio, inside real, inside complex. rand-seed is the same set as int. unit, the reals from 0 to 1, is inside real and overlaps int and ratio. bool, string, color, point and none are separate, and so is each list type, such as list[T1] and list[T2], and each modular type, such as angle, which is (mod real 0 360), and (mod int 0 12). Among the objects, shape holds a box for each shape type (circle, rect, ellipse, line, triangle, polyline, polygon, bezier, arc, ring, text and group) and every motif type, and each motif holds its variants: motif M1 holds variants M11 and M12, and motif M2 holds variants M21 and M22. movement holds move, score and every animation type, and each animation holds its variants: animation A1 holds variants A11 and A12, and animation A2 holds variants A21 and A22. instant is inside movement and overlaps move and score. ease, curve and colormap are inside func, font is inside record, and scene, formula and term are separate. page-object holds component, which holds view and control, and listener. control holds jumper and mover. writer holds control and listener.
